title: Genetic architecture and cross-platform validation of apolipoprotein A-IV concentrations.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC record (PMID 42449406): not in PMC, no full text, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. GWAS Catalog v2 API query by PMID returned 0 studies, so no deposited summary statistics found there.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: GWAS (genome-wide association study) meta-analysis of apoA-IV measured by ELISA in 25,181 people plus Olink proteomics in 33,995 UK Biobank participants (total 59,176); 13 associated loci.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked: no deposited data found (no supplement, no GWAS Catalog entry, no repository hits). Individual-level genotypes and apoA-IV levels come from cohorts and UK Biobank, which require an access application.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Only summary statistics (per-variant effect sizes) would plausibly be public; a per-person apoA-IV label is not available without controlled access, so no supervised table exists.

a3_inputs_present.note: Genotypes are controlled-access; not checked in files because nothing downloadable was found.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked in files; ELISA concentrations presumably mg/dL per paper description.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper reports 59,176 individuals, but none accessible; not verified.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Summary statistics would fit; individual-level genotypes would not matter as they are inaccessible.

a8_label_provenance.note: Label would be a physical measurement (ELISA or Olink assay), not a model output, per abstract.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim possible: per-person data is controlled-access and no public summary statistics were found.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a person's genetic variants to predict their blood level of apolipoprotein A-IV, a lipid-transport protein.
plain_idea.train_on: Genotypes of individuals from European cohorts and UK Biobank; reported 59,176 people, but none accessible (verified count: unknown).
plain_idea.predict: Blood apoA-IV concentration measured by ELISA (antibody assay) or Olink proteomic assay.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: A genetic predictor of apoA-IV could serve kidney and lipid epidemiology, but standard polygenic scores already do this and the data is locked.

ml_idea: Polygenic prediction of apoA-IV levels; infeasible because individual-level data require UK Biobank/cohort applications and no summary statistics were found deposited.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Search GWAS Catalog for the summary statistics by PMID: done, 0 studies found.

verdict_reason: A1/A2 fail: GWAS (genome-wide association study) of one protein whose per-person data is controlled-access (UK Biobank and cohorts); no supplement, repository deposit or GWAS Catalog summary statistics found, and no per-sample label table exists for ML.
